attackers_goals: Use a legitimate user and connect to a VPN service to gain access to the network.
description: A user accessed a VPN with an abnormal operating system.
investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user has really moved to a new operating system). Follow actions and suspicious activities regarding the user.
